column1: # One routine, two names: the MajorBBS/Worldgroup API renames.
# `GALPORT.C` rows are the authority and need no inference. Galacticomm shipped
# a porting tool for exactly this -- SRC/devutils/galport/GALPORT.C, "help
# developers port their add-on source code from Worldgroup v2.x to v3.x" --
# whose `changes[]` array literally maps each old name to its new one. 67 of its
# 91 entries are btv*->dfa* API renames; the other 24 are C type spellings
# (int->INT and friends) and are not reproduced here.
# The `ordinals:` rows are inferred by comparing two ordinal tables that share
# one numbering, and they exist to catch pairs GALPORT.C does not name -- the
# MAJORBBS-generation renames like free/galfree and malloc/galmalloc. They are
# weaker evidence and labelled as such.
# The `ordinal` column is the export slot where some table names one of the two.
# `-` means neither table does, which is normal for a GALPORT.C pair: many of
# those names are macros over the ordinal-exported primitives rather than
# exports of their own, which is exactly why an ordinal comparison alone found
# Regenerate: parse GALPORT.C's `changes[]` for pairs whose target starts with
# re/wg33src/LIB/wg2/WGSERVER.DEF and against each other by ordinal. Committed
# TRAP: the committed wgserver_wg300/wg312/wg33 tables are a DIFFERENT ordinal
# space -- @48 is _FFLUSH there against __WRITE, @326 is _CHOOWD against
# _GETMSG -- and must never be diffed against the MAJORBBS ones. Same trap
